description.en:
Basic Attack

Jianxin performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack

Jianxin consumes STA to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Jianxin consumes STA to plunge and unleash a powerful kick, dealing Aero DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Jianxin melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Aero DMG.

Heavy Attack

Jianxin mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Jianxin mengonsumsi STA untuk menukik dan melepaskan tendangan dahsyat, memberikan Aero DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en:
Hold Resonance Skill to enter Parry Stance.

Chi Counter

When Jianxin is attacked in the Parry Stance, she does not take damage and immediately performs Chi Counter, dealing Aero DMG.

Chi Parry

Release the Resonance Skill button during Parry Stance to interrupt Parry Stance and perform Chi Parry, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id:
Tahan Resonance Skill untuk memasuki Parry Stance.

Chi Counter

Saat Jianxin diserang dalam Parry Stance, ia tidak menerima damage dan langsung melakukan Chi Counter, memberikan Aero DMG.

Chi Parry

Lepas tombol Resonance Skill saat Parry Stance untuk menghentikan Parry Stance dan melakukan Chi Parry, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en: Create a strong wind field, continuously pulling targets within the wind field to the center and dealing Aero DMG. When the wind field disappears, it will trigger an explosion to deal Aero DMG to all targets within the range again.
description.id: Menciptakan medan angin kuat yang terus menarik target di dalamnya ke pusat dan memberikan Aero DMG. Saat medan angin menghilang, terjadi ledakan yang memberikan Aero DMG lagi kepada semua target dalam jangkauan.

description.en: Damage of Resonance Liberation Purification Force Field is increased by 20%.
description.id: DMG Resonance Liberation Purification Force Field meningkat sebesar 20%.

description.en: The Shield obtained from Heavy Attack Primordial Chi Spiral is increased by 20%.
description.id: Shield yang didapat dari Heavy Attack Primordial Chi Spiral meningkat sebesar 20%.

description.en: Pull in targets within the range, dealing Aero DMG.
description.id: Menarik target dalam jangkauan, memberikan Aero DMG.

description.en:
Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral

When "Chi" reaches max stacks, hold Basic Attack to cast Primordial Chi Spiral and start Zhoutian Progress.

Zhoutian Progress

Jianxin's resistance to interruption is increased, and her the damage taken is reduced by 50%:
Jianxin continuously consumes "Chi" and casts Chi Strike to attack targets nearby, dealing Aero DMG.
As Zhoutian Progress accumulates, Jianxin reaches different Zhoutian and gains effects accordingly.
-Before Minor Zhoutian: Gain Zhoutian Progress 1 shield. When Zhoutian Progress is interrupted, cast Pushing Punch to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
-Minor Zhoutian: Gain Zhoutian Progress 2 shield and cast Shock to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG. When Zhoutian Progress is interrupted, cast Yielding Pull to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
-Major Zhoutian - Inner: Gain Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and cast Shock to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG. When Zhoutian Progress is interrupted, cast Yielding Pull to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
-Major Zhoutian - Outer: Gain Zhoutian Progress 3 shield and cast Shock to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.
-When Basic Attack button is released, interrupt Zhoutian Progress and lose all "Chi";
-When all "Chi" is consumed, end Zhoutian Progress.

When Zhoutian Progress ends, regain a shield according to the Zhoutian Progress reached;
As the shield provided by Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral persists, the active character is healed once every 6s.

Chi

Jianxin can hold up to 120 Chi.
Chi is obtained when Normal Attack Fengyiquan hits the target.
Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skill Calming Air is cast.
Chi is obtained when the Resonance Skills Chi Counter or Chi Parry hits the target.
Chi is obtained when the Intro Skill Essence of Tao hits the target.
description.id:
Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral

Saat "Chi" mencapai stack maksimal, tahan Basic Attack untuk melancarkan Primordial Chi Spiral dan memulai Zhoutian Progress.

Zhoutian Progress

Ketahanan Jianxin terhadap interupsi meningkat, dan damage yang diterima berkurang 50%:
Jianxin terus mengonsumsi "Chi" dan melancarkan Chi Strike untuk menyerang target di sekitar, memberikan Aero DMG.
Seiring Zhoutian Progress terakumulasi, Jianxin mencapai Zhoutian yang berbeda dan mendapat efek yang sesuai.
-Sebelum Minor Zhoutian: Mendapat shield Zhoutian Progress 1. Saat Zhoutian Progress terinterupsi, lancarkan Pushing Punch untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.
-Minor Zhoutian: Mendapat shield Zhoutian Progress 2 dan melancarkan Shock untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG. Saat Zhoutian Progress terinterupsi, lancarkan Yielding Pull untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.
-Major Zhoutian - Inner: Mendapat shield Zhoutian Progress 3 dan melancarkan Shock untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG. Saat Zhoutian Progress terinterupsi, lancarkan Yielding Pull untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.
-Major Zhoutian - Outer: Mendapat shield Zhoutian Progress 3 dan melancarkan Shock untuk menyerang target, memberikan Aero DMG.
-Saat tombol Basic Attack dilepas, Zhoutian Progress terinterupsi dan seluruh "Chi" hilang;
-Saat seluruh "Chi" habis dikonsumsi, Zhoutian Progress berakhir.

Saat Zhoutian Progress berakhir, mendapat kembali shield sesuai Zhoutian Progress yang dicapai;
Selama shield dari Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral bertahan, karakter yang aktif dipulihkan HP-nya sekali setiap 6 dtk.

Chi

Jianxin dapat menyimpan hingga 120 Chi.
Chi didapat saat Normal Attack Fengyiquan mengenai target.
Chi didapat saat Resonance Skill Calming Air dilancarkan.
Chi didapat saat Resonance Skill Chi Counter atau Chi Parry mengenai target.
Chi didapat saat Intro Skill Essence of Tao mengenai target.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: The incoming Resonator has their Resonance Liberation DMG Amplified by 38% for 14s or until they are switched out.
description.id: Resonance Liberation DMG Resonator yang masuk di-Amplify sebesar 38% selama 14 dtk atau hingga diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: After casting Intro Skill Essence of Tao, Jianxin gains 100% extra Chi from Basic Attacks for 10s.
description.id: Setelah Intro Skill Essence of Tao dilancarkan, Jianxin mendapat 100% Chi ekstra dari Basic Attack selama 10 dtk.

description.en: Resonance Skill Calming Air can be used 1 more time.
description.id: Resonance Skill Calming Air dapat digunakan 1 kali lagi.

description.en: After staying in the Parry Stance of Resonance Skill Calming Air for 2.5s, Resonance Skill Chi Counter becomes immediately available.
description.id: Setelah berada dalam Parry Stance Resonance Skill Calming Air selama 2,5 dtk, Resonance Skill Chi Counter langsung dapat digunakan.

description.en: When performing Forte Circuit Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral, Jianxin's Resonance Liberation Purification Force Field DMG is increased by 80% for 14s.
description.id: Saat melakukan Forte Circuit Heavy Attack: Primordial Chi Spiral, Resonance Liberation Purification Force Field DMG Jianxin meningkat sebesar 80% selama 14 dtk.

description.en: The range of Resonance Liberation Purification Force Field is increased by 33%.
description.id: Jangkauan Resonance Liberation Purification Force Field meningkat sebesar 33%.

description.en: During Forte Circuit Heavy Attack: Primordial Qi Spiral, if Jianxin performs Pushing Punch, enhanced Resonance Skill Special Chi Counter can be used 1 time(s) in 5s. Special Chi Counter: Deals Aero DMG equal to 556.67% of Jianxin's ATK, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. Obtain a Zhoutian Progress 4 Shield (Benefits from Inherent Skill Reflection's bonus effect.)
description.id: Selama Forte Circuit Heavy Attack: Primordial Qi Spiral, jika Jianxin melakukan Pushing Punch, Resonance Skill Special Chi Counter yang ditingkatkan dapat digunakan 1 kali dalam 5 dtk. Special Chi Counter: Memberikan Aero DMG sebesar 556,67% ATK Jianxin, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG. Mendapat shield Zhoutian Progress 4 (Mendapat manfaat dari efek bonus Inherent Skill Reflection.)
